render_method: Blender 4.3 Eevee; exterior imports the actual final STL. Cutaway imports an OpenSCAD Simple X-half derivative created by subtracting a box from that actual STL; the orange line is the verified die-path centerline.

isometric.manual_visual_inspection: Exterior, outlet, catch tray, upright stance, and preserved ornament are clearly visible.

front_minus_y.manual_visual_inspection: Front is -Y; unicorn relief and rounded outlet into the bottom tray are unobstructed.

back_plus_y.manual_visual_inspection: Back is +Y; the rounded 46 x 42 mm loading inlet fully penetrates into the core.

cutaway_verified_path.manual_visual_inspection: Actual-STL X-half cutaway shows the hollow core, all three staggered 45-degree baffle levels, closed floor, and orange verified center path.
